FUTURE_TRADE_AFTER_15M.definition: At least one valid BUY or SELL event in (launch_time + 15m, launch_time + 20m].

FUTURE_TRADE_AFTER_30M.definition: At least one valid BUY or SELL event in (launch_time + 30m, launch_time + 35m].

FUTURE_TRADE_AFTER_60M.definition: At least one valid BUY or SELL event in (launch_time + 60m, launch_time + 65m].

secondary_outcomes.NO_ACTIVITY_THROUGH_HORIZON: No valid trade in (decision_time, launch_time + horizon]. This is descriptive and not used as the primary model label.
secondary_outcomes.TIME_TO_LAST_TRADE: Last valid trade timestamp in the observed venue-aware tape; right-censored at collection end.

eligibility.provider_gap: Never converted to inactivity; interval completeness is required for a binary primary label.
eligibility.right_censoring: If the positive interval extends beyond the observed collection boundary, label RIGHT_CENSORED.
eligibility.migration: Migration is not death; PumpSwap continuation is required for a venue-aware label when migration precedes the interval.
eligibility.future_only: Every primary outcome event is strictly after every allowed decision timestamp.
eligibility.mark_outcomes: Price marks remain secondary and conditional on observability; no tolerance change is introduced here.

modeling.baseline: A_survival token-state levels at decision time
modeling.independence_unit: mint; cluster decision-time rows by token
modeling.validation: 2026-08-28 development, 2026-08-29 chronological sanity evaluation; preliminary only
